spans.s: (I)--the seven worlds, white in colour, are one above the other umbrella-like. Br. II. २१. १९; III. ४९. २३; ५५. १५; IV. ३७. ३५.

(II)--the white umbrella as insignia of royalty given to कामेश्वर by विष्णु; lofty as the sky.
1: Br. IV. १५. २३; १७. 1; Vi. II. १३. ९६.
Kauravas threatened Ugrasena to deprive him of that.
2: Vi. V. ३५. १४.
